spatialElements.title: V8 engine block
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: The user wants to understand how parts work together, so the whole assembly is shown as a manipulable 3D model rather than a diagram.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Staged on the table at tabletop scale so the user can walk around it and explode it without it occupying the whole room.

spatialElements.title: Piston (×4 of 8)
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: Pulled out as an exploded part so its motion can be isolated and explained on its own.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Floated above-left of the block, anchored relative to the block so it reads as 'a part of this engine'.

spatialElements.title: Crankshaft
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: Shown as a model that can spin, because the point is to simulate how reciprocating pistons become rotation.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Brought to the front edge of the table at the user's eye-line so the rotation is easy to read.

spatialElements.title: Camshaft
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: A simple rotating model is enough to show valve timing.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Placed above and behind the block, the position it occupies in a real engine.

spatialElements.title: Spark plug (×8)
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: Highlighted as a small target part because it is the ignition point being called out.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Floated to the right of the block as a callout, anchored to the assembly.

spatialElements.title: Inspection controls
spatialElements.whyThisRepresentation: A 2D control panel (object-local UI) hosts explode/rotate/isolate toggles for the assembly.
spatialElements.whyThisPlacement: Placed to the right of the user (body-local locus of control) so controls are reachable without occluding the engine.

attentionPlan.narration: This is a V8 engine — eight cylinders arranged in a V. Let's take it apart.
Each piston is pushed down by combustion. There are eight.
The crankshaft turns that up-and-down motion into rotation.
The camshaft times when each valve opens and closes.
Spark plugs ignite the fuel-air mixture at the top of each cylinder.
